views.front: The circular door now has a continuous metal rim and fitted gasket; the two straight horizontal gasket chords are gone. The control strip and cabinet silhouette remain intact.
views.rear: The plain rear panel, rounded cabinet corners and continuous lower edge remain intact. No new geometry protrudes through the back or sides.
views.detail: The enlarged door shows a smooth round glass edge, a continuous fine gasket on the rim and a rounded dial; the existing small right-side latch remains seated.
views.underside: The low view shows the circular door projection seated against the cabinet without crossing trim or loose gasket lines. The cabinet bottom remains closed.
views.clay: The untextured view retains clear concentric door layers and clean rounded case edges; no floating straight gasket geometry remains above or below the door.
